programme.title: Lady Gaga -- Live in London 2013

programme.title: Jimi Hendrix - American Landing : Live at Monterey

programme.title: Animal Science
programme.desc: Animals are a popular subject of TV shows, including shows that take a look at the behavior of the creatures. "Animal Science" goes a step further than that by examining the science behind the behaviors, which explains how and why an animal is able to excel in its environment. The half-hour program uses information from researchers, animations and graphics to help viewers better understand the creatures and their actions.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth
programme.desc: If you're expecting this show to feature locations like Antarctica and the North Pole, you may be disappointed because the "coolest" in the title refers to how impressive a place is, not its temperature. Instead, the show explores the history and culture of cities and landmarks that are among the most astonishing sites on the planet. Each episode features three locations, showcasing the history, geography and traditions of each to help young people gain a better understanding of the diverse world in which they live.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.title: Descending
programme.desc: In this 13-part documentary series, hosts Scott Wilson and Ellis Emmett descend beneath the surface to explore the three-quarters of the planet that is covered in water. Each episode features a new location, where Wilson and Emmett discover all that the area has to offer. They explore the cultures of the local people, share stories of human triumph and tragedy, and connect the world on land to the one in the sea. With each dive into the unknown, they encounter creatures and sights that most people will never get to experience.

The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid Apocalypse
programme.desc: Twelve Naked and Afraid All-Stars take on punishing locations together. The survivalists try to last up to 60 days with no food, water, clothes or shelter. Does teaming with other elite survivalists help their chances or make the challenge more difficult?

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri wakes up and finds Indravadhan still on his chair, guarding her room. She then learns from the secretary that Indravadhan was taking care of her throughout the night. Gayatri does not wake up Indravadhan, instead, she decides to prepare the coffee before waking him up. Gayatri then learns that Indravadhan has decided to sell a fort in order to pay the loan. She then decides to help Indravadhan out in any way possible. She takes the responsibility of cleaning the house in order to save the money that would be paid to the servants. In the process she hurts herself and loses consciousness. The doctor too declares that he cannot save Gayatri now. What would Indravadhan do now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan takes an unconscious Gayatri to the mosque where a Baba treats her. He asks Indravadhan about his whereabouts. Indravadhan does not reveal to the Baba that he is just a soldier. It is also revealed that Kuwar Singh's son has engaged in a gay relationship with a slave. Kuwar Singh scolds his son and asks him to keep in mind that, Indravadhan is not going to leave his throne. Kuwar Singh then asks his son to plan a baby as soon as possible. Kuwar Singh's son claims that he can do anything but will never plan a baby. What will Kuwar Singh's reaction be when he learns this? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri regains her consciousness and finds that Indravadhan's behavior has changed. Gayatri questions Indravadhan as to why he is doing this. Indravadhan claims that he is the one who has hurt her and it is his responsibility to take care of her. On the other hand, Kuwar's son beats up his wife and claims that he does not want to live with her. While Gayatri and Indravadhan on the other hand, are staying in the former's friend's place where they do not get sufficient food for two people. Indravadhan rejects from having the food and asks Gayatri to eat it alone. How will Gayatri convince Indravadhan to share the food? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan cries before Gayatri and claims that he had forgotten to fulfil the responsibility of a husband. Gayatri consoles Indravadhan by saying that he is a good person and knows how to fulfil the responsibilities as common man and as well as a king. Hearing this, Indravadhan leaves Gayatri and walks away. A confused Gayatri thinks as to what wrong she said to Indravadhan. On the other hand, Swarnlekha confronts Kuwar Singh and Kokila and shows her wounds to them. She tells her in-laws that she is going back to her home and is also going to complain about her husband. What will Kuwar Singh and Kokila do now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Indravadhan finds Gayatri missing, he decides to search for her. On the other hand, Gayatri is held at gunpoint. She is then tied up to a chair by the baba and the family with whom Indravadhan and Gayatri were staying. Indravadhan too is held by the family and tied up to a wall. Later, Indravadhan questions Gayatri as to why she did not inform him about anything. Gayatri replies to Indravadhan that he was not ready to hear anything from her. On the other hand, Kuwar Singh and Kokila talk about Swarnlekha and her decision. They decide to talk with their son and convince him. While on the other hand, Gayatri and Indravadhan try to set themselves free and escape. Will Indravadhan and Gayatri be able to set themselves free? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan and Gayatri return home and they are confronted by Raj Mata. Raj Mata acts as though she does not know what actually had happened in the lives of Indravadhan and Gayatri. After the 'Aarti' the couple are welcomed in the house. Later, Indravadhan finds Gayatri struggling to tie a knot at her back. Indravadhan attends her and ties the knot up for her. On the other hand, Kokila meets Swarnlekha and threatens her. While on the other hand, Gayatri is suspicious as to how could Swarnlekha fall sick? Will Gayatri learn about Swarnlekha's condition? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Raj mata spots a spy in the Raj Mahal and follows her. She fails to catch up as the spy manages to evade Raj Mata. The spy then meets Kuwar Singh and gets some orders from him and meanwhile, Raj Mata informs Gayatri about the spy in the Raj Mahal. Later, Gayatri's brother meets her and invites her for an event being held at his home. When Gayatri's brother invites Raj Mata to the event, she declines the invitation. On hearing this, Indravadhan speaks up saying that he would attend the event. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ranaji and Gayatri reach her house for the Pooja. When Gayatri asks whether he is still angry or not, Ranaji says that he left his anger outside. Kuwar's spy follows the two of them to keep an eye on them. Later Damyianti thanks Ranaj for accepting Gayatri as his wife and he is then asked to wear a dhoti for the Pooja. When he struggles with draping himself, Gayatri helps him. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek thi Rani to find out more.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri wakes up and realizes that Indravadhan has not yet returned. She decides to ask her mother where Indravadhan has gone. When Indravadhan comes back she confronts him and yells at him. Indravadhan apologizes to Gayatri and says that he failed to realize her importance in his life. He then puts a bangle around Gayatri's wrist and claims that he has given her all the rights as a queen, and as well as a wife. In return, Indravadhan requests Gayatri to forgive him. The next day, events are held at Gayatri's home in which both she and Indravadhan participate. What are the events that Indravadhan and Gayatri participate in? Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Gayatri finds that her things are missing from her room she asks Ranaji who moved her things. Ranaji says it was on his orders that her things were moved out so they can stay together. What will Gayatri's reaction be with this change in Ranaji? Keep watchin Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI

The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.desc: The Yoon Daehyeong faction schemes to place Bogyeong as the future queen of Gyotaejeon. Ahead of the royal selection of the Crown Princess, Hwon secretly expresses his wish for Yeonwoo to submit her maiden registration. Meanwhile, Princess Minhwa's feelings for Yeom deepen, and she stubbornly demands that the king grant her permission to marry him.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.5
programme.desc: Yeonwoo remains at the royal villa, Eunwol Pavilion, devoting herself to rigorous court etiquette training. Unable to withstand the Queen Dowager Yoon's threats, Nokyoung casts a forbidden spell on Yeonwoo. Cast out of the palace and sent back to her family, Yeonwoo's illness steadily worsens. In secret, Nokyoung approaches Yeonwoo's father with a dangerous proposal.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.6
programme.desc: Trapped in terror inside a coffin, Yeonwoo is ultimately rescued by Nokyoung and returned to the world—only to awaken with all her memories erased. Taking Yeonwoo's place, Bogyeong ascends as Crown Princess. As Crown Prince Hwon comes of age, the kingdom's political situation grows ever more precarious under the schemes of powerful in-law families.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.7
programme.desc: Nokyoung repeatedly warns Yeonwoo to be wary of strangers. Defying Seol's pleas, Yeonwoo ventures into the streets, drawn by her desire to glimpse the king's royal procession. Catching sight of Hwon from afar, Yeonwoo is thrown into deep confusion.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Younha! Younha began her career in 2003 in Japan with her first single “ゆびきり.” Then she found mainstream success the following year with her second Japanese single “ほうき星 (Comet)” which was included on the soundtrack of the anime series “Bleach.” The song peaked on the Oricon Chart at #15 giving her the nickname of the “Oricon Comet.” Her success in the island country led to her debut in Korea as well she debuted in Korea in 2016 where she is regarded as one of the country's best singer-songwriters. From “Waiting” to “Password 486” Younha has many hit songs under her belt. She has also collaborated with numerous A-list musicians including Toy and Epik High. In November last year Younha released her sixth full-length album “END THEORY” to once again prove how versatile of a musician she is. From rock to ballad music she covered various genres in the album and the album's lead single “Stardust” was chosen as one of Billboard's Best K-pop Songs of the Year. In this episode Younha performs “Stardust” “Wish” “Waiting” “How U doing” and more to nourish our hearts. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Kuonechan is a rising star in Korean R&B circles known for his sweet voice and heartwarming music. After debuting in the music scene with the EP “Repetition” in September 2017 he diligently pursued his career releasing a total of three EPs within a year. He's now actively collaborating with big names in the industry including Baek Yerin Jang Sukhoon Humbert and Fisherman and making his distinctive mark in the industry. This artist recently finished his mandatory military duties and announced a new chapter in his career. In this episode Kuonechan performs his new single “Expression” as well as “Don't be sad” “How Did You” and more to nourish our souls. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer ALi! ALi burst into the music scene in 2005 as a guest vocalist for Leessang. Thanks to her unique voice and expressive vocals she mesmerized the public immediately and then she made her debut as a solo artist in 2009 with the album “After The Love Has Gone.” In the competition program “Immortal Songs” she presented her own covers of various masterpieces including “Leopard of Kilimanjaro” and “I Have a Girlfriend” and gained both popular and critical acclaim. In December last year ALi released the remake album “Adolescence” which is composed of the five songs that had a huge influence on her back in her 20's and 30's to share with listeners how she makes the most of the youngest day of her life. In this episode ALi performs “For lovers who hesitate” “Break away” and “Please wait for me” from her latest album as well as “Eraser” and “The way the light.” Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. Both cars offer plenty of crash avoidance technology but do not include some of the latest advancements introduced in the market. The cars' four-star ratings apply also to their PHEV variants.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.
